title: Cylinder 8 Glow Plug Circuit Range/Performance
plain: The glow plug for cylinder 8 is drawing more or less current than the computer expects. Glow plugs heat the cylinders so a diesel engine starts easily in cold weather.
symptoms: Rough running or white smoke right after a cold start

causes.name: High resistance from a corroded or loose glow plug connector

checks: Measure the cylinder 8 glow plug resistance and current draw
Inspect the glow plug connector for corrosion
fix: Usually a new glow plug or a connector repair.

title: Cylinder 1 Glow Plug Incorrect
plain: The computer thinks the glow plug in cylinder 1 is the wrong type for this engine. Glow plugs heat the cylinders so a diesel engine starts easily in cold weather.
symptoms: Possible hard starting in cold weather

causes.name: Mixed glow plug types after a partial replacement

checks: Confirm the installed glow plug part number matches the engine
Measure the glow plug resistance
fix: Install the correct glow plug for the engine.

title: Internal Control Module Ignition Coil Control Performance
plain: The part of the engine computer that fires the ignition coils failed a self-check.

causes.name: Shorted ignition coil or coil wiring overloading the driver
Low voltage or poor power and ground connections
Computer software that needs an update

checks: Check for misfire or coil circuit codes
Inspect ignition coil wiring and connectors
Test the battery and computer grounds
fix: Replace any shorted coil or repair wiring first; otherwise the computer may need replacement.
